sprints.name: Sprint 1: Infrastructure and Scaffolding (The Bedrock)
sprints.goal: Have a 'Dockerized' environment where Frontend and Backend run and communicate basically.

user_stories.name: As DevOps, I want a unified docker-compose, to lift the entire stack with a single command.
verification_criteria: ✅ (Positive) Executing `docker compose up` lifts 3 containers: api-server, client-desktop and chromadb.
✅ (Positive) Persistence volumes are created in `./data`.
✅ (Positive) The backend is accessible at localhost:8000/docs.
❌ (Negative) If Docker is not installed, the setup script fails with a readable error message and does not explode.

user_stories.name: As Backend Dev, I want the base structure of FastAPI, to start developing endpoints on a clean architecture.
verification_criteria: ✅ (Positive) GET `/health` endpoint returns 200 OK.
✅ (Positive) The folder structure strictly follows the architecture map.
✅ (Positive) `poetry install` installs dependencies without conflicts.
❌ (Negative) The `ruff` linter fails if trying to commit unformatted code (simulated in pre-commit).

sprints.name: Sprint 2: The RAG Brain (Knowledge Injection)
sprints.goal: Endow the system with memory. Make it capable of reading Tech Packs and vectorizing them.

user_stories.name: As Architect, I want the system to read Markdown files from `packages/knowledge_base`, to feed the AI context.
verification_criteria: ✅ (Positive) The script recursively traverses folders.
✅ (Positive) Metadata (title, path) are extracted correctly.
✅ (Positive) Large files are divided into logical chunks (Semantic Splitting).
❌ (Negative) Files that are not `.md` or hidden system files are ignored.

user_stories.name: As System, I want to vectorize the content and store it in ChromaDB, to retrieve it semantically.
verification_criteria: ✅ (Positive) The `chroma_data` folder increases in size after ingestion.
✅ (Positive) A test query returns fragments from the correct Tech Pack.
✅ (Positive) Works offline using local embeddings.
❌ (Negative) If ChromaDB is down, the system throws controlled error `SYS_001` (ConnectionRefused).

sprints.name: Sprint 3: Project-First Sequential Document Generation (The Architect's Assistant)
sprints.goal: Implement Project-First paradigm: sequential document generation (25 docs), guided RAG (100% templates), iterative validation with persistent storage.

user_stories.name: As User, I want an IDE-like interface (ProjectShell) to create and manage local projects, so I have full control over my architectures.
user_stories.description: Project-First Paradigm: UI Foundation. Desktop interface with Sidebar for project list, modal to create projects (name + base path), Dashboard showing progress (Doc N/25), File tree panel showing context/ structure.
verification_criteria: ✅ (Positive) Create project modal opens and accepts name + base path.
✅ (Positive) Sidebar lists all created projects and auto-updates.
✅ (Positive) Selecting project loads ProjectDashboard with progress bar (Doc 0/25).
✅ (Positive) UI follows DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (Dark Mode, responsive).
✅ (Positive) File tree panel (right sidebar) shows context/10-CONTEXT, 20-REQUIREMENTS, etc.
❌ (Negative) No persistence until HU-3.2 complete (backend I/O).
technical_tasks: Implement `ProjectDashboard` widget (summary + chat + file tree stubs).
Integrate with FileSystemService (HU-3.2) for read-only operations.
Unit tests: ProjectSidebar, modal interaction (>85% coverage).

user_stories.name: As Backend, I want a FileSystemService to safely create/read/write project structures, ensuring permission validation and audit trails.
user_stories.description: Core infrastructure: Backend file I/O motor. Auto-create context/10-CONTEXT, 20-REQUIREMENTS, 30-ARCHITECTURE, 35-UX_UI, 40-PLANNING directories. Validate permissions before write. Implement idempotent project creation. Audit trail on all writes.
verification_criteria: ✅ (Positive) create_project() creates structure idempotently (no errors if exists).
✅ (Positive) get_project_state() returns correct list of existing documents.
✅ (Positive) write_validated_document() backs up previous version before overwrite.
✅ (Positive) Validates permissions (throw if no write access).
✅ (Positive) Path traversal attacks prevented (no ../ escapes).
✅ (Positive) Audit log created at project/.audit.log.
❌ (Negative) Endpoint not yet written (HU-4.x responsibility).
technical_tasks: Unit tests: >90% coverage (file ops, permissions, backup logic).

user_stories.name: As User, I want the system to generate 25 documents sequentially (guided by RAG templates), allowing me to iterate before saving each one.
user_stories.description: Core feature: Sequential document generation pipeline. User describes project once. System generates Doc 1-25 sequentially (never parallel). RAG 100% guided by templates (01-TEMPLATES/). User can iterate in chat (refine) or validate (persist). Chat history in BD, docs on disk.
verification_criteria: ✅ (Positive) Chat accepts project description and initiates Doc 1 proposal.
✅ (Positive) Backend loads template (e.g., 01-TEMPLATES/10-CONTEXT.md) and adapts to project.
✅ (Positive) RAG uses Ollama/Groq to fill template placeholders.
✅ (Positive) Frontend shows proposal in markdown preview with 'Accept' | 'Edit' | 'Reject' buttons.
✅ (Positive) Chat flow is 100% sequential: Doc 1 → Doc 2 → ... → Doc 25 (never parallel).
✅ (Positive) UX Control: Send button (➤) disables visually (gray) if text field is empty or whitespace-only.
✅ (Positive) UX Tools: Code blocks rendered include 'Copy' button in header to save content to clipboard.
✅ (Positive) Streaming response: Token-by-token display (<200ms latency, no wait for full response).
❌ (Negative) No docs saved if user doesn't explicitly Accept.
technical_tasks: Create `TextEditingController` listener for managing send button `isEnabled` state.
Implement `CodeBlockHeader` widget with Clipboard integration for 'Copy' functionality.
Create `ProjectMetadataService` to track project state and last doc generated.
Implement chat endpoint `POST /api/v1/chat/message` for proposal generation.
Implement `POST /api/v1/documents/validate` endpoint to persist validated docs.
Unit tests: Proposal generation, state transitions, input validation (>85%).

user_stories.name: As System, I want resilient error handling and validation gates, so document generation gracefully handles RAG timeouts, disk errors, and user mistakes.
user_stories.description: Resilience layer: Error recovery. RAG timeout (>30s) triggers auto-retry (3x with backoff). Disk full → clear message. Permission denied → specific error per OS. All errors logged to context/40-PLANNING/ERROR_LOG.md.
verification_criteria: ✅ (Positive) If RAG timeout: Auto-retry 3 times (1s, 2s, 4s delays).
✅ (Positive) After 3 retries: Show template placeholder + 'RAG unavailable' message.
✅ (Positive) Disk full error: Message 'Free 500MB to continue'.
✅ (Positive) Permission denied: 'Check permissions on /context directory'.
✅ (Positive) All errors logged with timestamp + user_id + error_code.
✅ (Positive) Frontend shows error notification (ScaffoldMessenger) with 5s auto-hide.
✅ (Positive) Manual error handling: User can click 'Retry' or 'Skip Document' in notification.
❌ (Negative) No retry if user rejects document.
technical_tasks: Implement error handler middleware in FastAPI.
Implement parametrizable notification duration for flexible error handling.
Unit tests: Simulate RAG timeout, disk full, permission errors (>90%).

user_stories.name: As User, I want streaming text generation (SSE) and optimized performance, so the UI feels responsive (<2s per document proposal).
user_stories.description: Performance optimization: Streaming + caching. Backend uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream text chunks. Frontend renders streaming text in real-time. Templates cached in memory. Embeddings pre-computed.
verification_criteria: ✅ (Positive) Latency: <500ms from 'Accept Doc N' button click to 'Generating Doc N+1...' on screen.
✅ (Positive) Streaming visible: User sees text appear token-by-token (not wait for full response).
✅ (Positive) 25-doc generation: <5 minutes total time.
✅ (Positive) Memory usage: Stays <500MB (no growth over 25 docs).
✅ (Positive) Benchmark tests confirm latency targets.
❌ (Negative) No GPU required (CPU-only target).
technical_tasks: Cache templates in memory (Redis or Python dict).
Pre-compute embeddings for 01-TEMPLATES/ on app startup.
Performance benchmarks: pytest + custom Flutter benchmark.
Memory profiling: Ensure no leaks over 25 docs.
